doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Classical study with his uncle Anton Rovinsky
summary: Hyman studied with several teachers and finally with his uncle, concert pianist Anton Rovinsky.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. In your early career, you were, when we listen to you play, we can tell that you had some classical training.

Yeah. I studied with an uncle of mine, other teachers too, but finally I was proficient enough to study with an uncle of mine who was a concert pianist. His names was Anton Rovinsky. And I learned a lot of things from him. I’m still learning from him actually, in a sense.
